description:
DESIGN
The design proposes to construct a 5.5m rear extension. The Rear extension is designed with flat roof  incorporating one lantern roof light, one flat rooflight, one window and a bifold door facing the rear garden. 

SCALE
The depth of the rear extension will be 5.5m. (Maximum allowance - 6m- Terraced House)
The height of the extension would be 2.98m at eaves and 3.82m at maximum point. The open space around the original house would be approx. 55.99% after the rear extension which is above 50% benchmark. 

MATERIAL
The finish material of the rear extension would be external render to match with existing. The windows and doors all would be of White uPVC. The flat roof of the extension will be finished with fiber glass with top coat or similar.

ACCESS
The existing front access will be used to enter the house.

SUMMARY
The design proposal creates harmonious relationship between the existing and proposed forms with its modest scale and proportion, adopting traditional design and using existing matching materials. It also complies with Schedule-2 Part-1 Class-A of the Town and Country Planning Order 1995. Thus humbly request to grant prior approval for the design.
